paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space
caption: figure
model_annotation: This chart illustrates scores achieved by different quality score methods, with the horizontal axis labeled "Quality Scores" containing three categories—IFD, TagNum, and DEITA—and the vertical axis labeled "Scores" ranging from 30 to 70 with tick intervals of 5 on a linear scale. Each category contains a grouped pair of bars: a light blue bar representing Avg_obj and a light peach/salmon bar representing Avg_sub. Two horizontal reference lines span the chart: a blue dashed line labeled "Base Avg_obj" at approximately 64.71, and an orange/yellow dashed line labeled "Base Avg_sub" at approximately 37.91. For the IFD category, the light blue Avg_obj bar reaches 63.98 and the peach Avg_sub bar reaches 41.90. For the TagNum category, the light blue bar reaches 66.06 and the peach bar reaches 39.13. For the DEITA category, the light blue bar reaches 67.64 and the peach bar reaches 42.99. The tallest bar in the chart is the DEITA Avg_obj bar at 67.64, while the shortest is the DEITA Avg_sub bar at 37.91 (which aligns closely with the Base Avg_sub reference line). The categories appear ordered from left to right as IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, and within each group the light blue bar is positioned behind or to the left of the peach bar. The reference line values of 64.71 and 37.91 are annotated at the right edge of the chart.
